patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — commercetools and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

commercetools and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose commercetools only if your buying job matches “Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; contact sale” rather than Shopware's shape. Choose Shopware only if your buying job matches “Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$6” rather than commercetools's shape. Workflow advantage: commercetools leans shared coverage; Shopware leans catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — commercetools and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: commercetools is Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; contact sales. Shopify keeps the SaaS award.; Shopware is Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$660/mo; Evolve from €2400/mo; Beyond quote..
- Company-size focus: commercetools (mid-market, enterprise) vs Shopware (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: commercetools-leaning — vs Shopware-leaning catalog-management.
- Researched limits: commercetools — No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Shopware — Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV.

Limitations — commercetools: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Requires front-end / MACH assembly — not a weekend theme launch; Shopware: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Rise commercial floor is high versus WooCommerce core + hosting.

Poor-fit cases: commercetools is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet · Shopware is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV · Avoid commercetools if you actually need Shopware's motion (Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Ris)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
